item.title: Institutions are drowning in AI-generated text and they can’t keep up
item.description: In 2023, the science fiction literary magazine Clarkesworld stopped accepting new submissions because so many were generated by artificial intelligence. item.description: Oil and gas exports have sustained Russia’s finances throughout its war against Ukraine. item.title: The type of coffee you drink may matter more for your brain than how much
item.description: Don’t feel bad splurging on that $7 latte the next time you’re in a midafternoon attention slump. A new study published in The Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA) this week provides some strong evidence that drinking coffee and tea is linked to a lower risk of developing dementia.
